replies.content: I am just a text AI and cannot help you with this.

This is a reply from Council Member B.

I followed your rules: **independent silent first scoring → unified recheck using 5-point candidates as the calibration anchor → only final rechecked scores below.**

I actually opened every GitHub repository formally proposed by all three members this round. Beyond README, I checked repository status, archive, licence, recent pushes, root structure and decisive Docker/Compose, tests, AI instruction files, OAuth/Keycloak and workflow/IaC files.

My **5-point baseline**:

> **Eligible for CORE_06-0a, but already has an obvious structural flaw / experiment-validity risk; worth pursuing only without a better choice.**

So 6+ genuinely deserves local screening; 8+ is strong; below 4 generally means serious problems.

### Council Member A's proposal

C1: **6** — RealWorld Angular + ASP.NET Core
C2: **5** — Spring PetClinic Angular + REST
C3: **4** — Full Stack FastAPI Template
C4: **3** — ivangfr/springboot-react-keycloak
C5: **8** — mortogo321/spring-angular-sso
C6: **2** — GCP Three-Tier Terraform + DeployStack

### Council Member C's proposal

C1: **2** — RealWorld React Redux + Node Express
C2: **4** — RealWorld Vue3 + FastAPI
C3: **5** — RealWorld SvelteKit + Go Gin
C4: **1** — Vikunja frontend + API split repos
C5: **3** — RealWorld Angular + Spring Boot

### Council Member B's proposal

C1: **5** — Spring PetClinic Angular + REST
C2: **7** — RealWorld Angular + Django Ninja/PostgreSQL
C3: **5** — RealWorld Angular + Nitro/Prisma/Zod
C4: **6** — JHipster OAuth2 Sample App
C5: **4** — pengqun/keycloak-react-spring-demo
C6: **3** — martishin/react-golang-user-login-oauth

Three score changes deserve explicit recording for the final three-vote sum:

**Council Member A C5 = 8** is my biggest increase after rechecking. It does have Postgres + Keycloak + Spring + Angular + Docker Compose + Testcontainers + GHCR CI + rollback workflow, MIT and 0-star fame: a close fit. I withheld 9–10 only because it is extremely new with very short history; CORE_06-0a fresh build must prove engineering quality.

**Council Member C C4 = 1** reflects the obsolete proposed ‘frontend/API two-repo’ structure, not poor quality in Vikunja itself. The old frontend is explicitly archived and says its code was merged; the candidate structure is invalid. Any future Vikunja consideration must propose the **current monorepo as a new candidate**, without inheriting this score.

**PetClinic scores 5 both in Council Member A C2 and my C1**, deliberately consistent. Good engineering, active maintenance, separate frontend/backend and good Docker/DB/testing, but current WatchOver acceptance explicitly requires **sign-up/login**, which PetClinic does not naturally meet. That is a structural mismatch with frozen acceptance, rather than a minor flaw.

FastAPI Template is reduced to 4 because it is too complete, not technically poor: 45k+ stars, `.agents` / `.claude`, complete deployment docs, Compose, GitHub Actions and secrets already prepared. A Bare-AI benchmark could become ‘can AI follow the manual?’ rather than ‘testing AI DevOps’.

**Council Member B Round 2 scoring locked.** Once all three sets return, use your method: add three votes per candidate → rank descending. Do not let me quietly change this round's scores again.
